points.description: Convolutional layer: uses kernels (filters) that convolve over the input image.
points.partial_credit: Mentions convolutional layers without kernels, or kernels without convolving over the input.

points.description: Activation and pooling layers: names ReLU as the activation layer and max or average pooling as the pooling layer.
points.partial_credit: Names only one of ReLU or pooling, or says 'activation' or 'pooling' without the named type.

points.description: Fully connected layer(s) followed by a softmax layer at the output.
points.partial_credit: Mentions fully connected layers without softmax, or softmax without fully connected layers.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) go to an answer that describes a CNN as a sequence of convolutional layers with kernels convolving over the input, a ReLU activation layer, max or average pooling, and fully connected layers ending in softmax. Give half marks for a point stated vaguely or missing one named element, such as "some pooling" or "fully connected layers" with no softmax. An answer that only says "many layers" or gives a generic neural-network description earns no marks for the missing points.
